notes: Topographic map series of New South Wales. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. Shows rivers, creeks, water holes, vegetation, public buildings, homesteads, classed roads, tracks, railways, power and telephone lines, parishes, portions, shires, rainfall and temperatures. Some sheets have series title: Topographic & orthophoto map 1:50 000; On panel: Auto-generated series. Some sheets published with a topographic map on recto and orthophoto map on verso.
